description: Mutes two signals when Rack starts and then fades them up over a second, so that a patch does not burst out at full level when it is loaded

params.text: Sets how long the silence lasts before the fade begins, 0 to 15 seconds

inputs.text: The left signal to be muted
The right signal to be muted

outputs.text: The left signal, silent during the mute, rising over the second after it and unchanged from then on
The right signal, silent during the mute, rising over the second after it and unchanged from then on

notes: the mute and the fade run once, when the module is created; after that the module passes its inputs straight through.
put it between a patch and the audio module, since it only mutes what passes through it.
